Recycle your silage bags, bunker covers,
and hoop film for FREE!
Bring plastic to the Sauk County Highway Shop,
620 Linn Street, Baraboo, 10am - Noon on
collection day.
Plastic should be in Recapture Bags or tied into
tight, manageable bundles. Recapture bags are
available at the Sauk County Land Resources &
Environment Department office. Farms may
receive 5 bags free annually. Each bag can hold
about 200 lbs. of plastic. SuperSacks are not
recyclable-we are trying to phase out of these.
Please either bundle your plastic or use the
provided bags.
All plastic is to be unloaded by hand and must be
a manageable weight and size to unload.
NO LOOSE PLASTIC
NO Bale netting / mesh. This material
should be landfilled.
